_comment: Category-tiered spend caps enforced by bridge/purchases.mjs BEFORE any virtual-card call. Defense-in-depth on top of the pre-funded card's bank ceiling. Edit numbers cautiously — the LLM cannot edit this file at runtime. Each merchant in merchant-allowlist.json carries a category that maps into 'categories' here; if a merchant's category is missing or 'default' is the catch-all.

categories._comment: Per-category caps. perTransactionMaxGbp is the single-purchase ceiling. dailyCapGbp / weeklyCapGbp / monthlyCapGbp are rolling totals; first one to trip wins.

tiers._comment: Confirmation requirement by amount, applied AFTER category cap passes. auto = LLM may proceed without operator confirm. voice = standard voice 'yes'/'no' gate. typed = HUD modal where operator types the amount to confirm (anti-injection — voice 'yes' cannot authorise). Tiers scale with per-tx cap so a £1500 camera lens doesn't auto-pay just because the cap permits it.

globalCaps._comment: Hard ceilings across ALL categories combined. Final safety net so a runaway loop hopping between categories can't drain the card. Must be >= the highest single-category per-tx cap (currently photography £1500) so the per-category cap is actually reachable in one purchase.
